instructor: THE MOST STUDENT FRIENDLY TEACHER EVER

Weakest: For later semesters, I think he needs to be more strict about homeworks since it is the only computational part in this course. Most of the TAs and assistants who conducted the office hours had no clue about the course. Not only were they not able to answer our questions, but they also gave wrong information all the time. They claimed that they took the course 4 years ago and that was the reason why they could not remember anything and solved the questions wrong. Instead of choosing students/ master students who do not study the course to solve the questions, some students who got a higher grade during this semester can be hired. Because most of the time, when some students asked them about how this solution can be done with the methods discussed in the class, the TAs had no clue and used their general knowledge (that was not true all the time). So, the office hours were misleading.

The only great assistant was the first one: Merve Eser. Others are really bad. In fact, they are the worst assistants I have ever seen. They even do not know the topic. In addition, I came to objection hour for my midterm and the assistant Zeynep Güven does not know the questions.  I was shocked. Then why not our teachers come to those office hours? Another assistant whose name was Tuba is also as bad as Zeynep. She was not able to explain questions in the office hour held for Quiz 2.
